//: AIDE settings overlay — project-owned, like aide.toml. While this file
exists, .claude/settings.json is REGENERATED on every install/--update as a
deterministic deep-merge of the framework default and this overlay — so
edit THIS file, never settings.json (your edits there are overwritten).
Merge rules: objects deep-merge (overlay wins). For list values (the
permission allow/ask/deny lists, hook groups) use the operator
{ "add": [...], "remove": [...] } — additive by default, so a framework
update that adds a new default still reaches you. A plain list replaces the
framework value outright (escape hatch). Prefer adding to `deny` over
removing from `allow` when tightening — deny is explicit and update-proof.
Keys starting with // are comments and never appear in the output.
FACET notes: the src/tests write-scope globs are NOT set here — the
installer templates them from aide.toml source_dir/tests_dir (src/segfacet,
tests). Permission rules promoted by /aide-review-permissions belong in the
`allow.add` list below, not in the generated settings.json.

//allow: Write(scripts/*.py) + Write(docs/*.md): both directories hold committed,
reviewed, non-shipped project artifacts (project tools and durable
technical documents — the shape of scripts/refresh_reference.py and
docs/reference-build.md), and an item whose deliverable is one of them
stalled an unattended builder on a prompt per file (insights.md,
item 118, 2026-08-27; approved at the 2026-08-30 triage). Single-star
globs match direct children only, so docs/aide/** living documents and
vision/roadmap stay PR-gated by their own entries.
